source: Chief Ondomon – another clod. Young and strong, sure, but not much more. Seems like only moments after I awoke in a strange shanty room, he barged in with a soldier type and a bearded old man. The clod said I was found floating on a flimsy raft with a bleeding bite wound on my leg, and then demanded to know how I reached Aslandian waters. Hah, if only this brute knew: I’ve been conning fools many times smarter than him ever since I could travel this broken world, from the societal collapse of the past decades to this era of water. His odd tribe was merely my next stop. My caretaker, a young woman called Daneve, was examining the stitched wound on my left leg where the crocodile had clamped down. (Now that I think of it, she paid the Chief no mind.) As usual, all of them did not expect my looks and my performance. I closed my eyes and chanted “Star-o-way, Star-o-way” and began to shed my tears. “I am Seece, Priestess of the Starways in the black brilliance of night, and I am delivered to you with message.” The bearded one rolled his eyes but the Chief was concerned and focused – exactly as I wanted. The rest was my usual schtick – I arrive from the East, I read the stars, they take me where I’m needed, there’s a dire warning, heed my wisdom, etc. Then I looked directly in the Chief's eyes and described the Blue Death approaching from the East. A disease brought by mosquito swarms as heavy as rolling fog. A disease that chokes our air pipes and saps color from our skin until it is pale blue. The bearded one whispered something to the Chief, who nodded and told me I’d have shelter and food until I recovered. As if they had any other choice.
target: 翁多蒙首領——又一個蠢蛋。年輕力壯，沒錯，但也就這樣。我在一間陌生的破木屋醒來，似乎才一會兒，他就帶著一個士兵模樣的人，和一位鬍子老頭闖進來。這蠢蛋說，他們發現我漂在一張脆弱的木筏上，腿上有個流血的咬傷，接著逼問我是怎麼來到阿斯蘭迪亞水域的。 哈，這粗人要是知道就好了：從我能在這破碎世界闖蕩起，就一直在騙比他聰明好幾倍的傻瓜。從過去幾十年的社會崩潰，到如今的水世界，都是如此。他這古怪部落，不過是我的下一站。照顧我的年輕女子叫丹妮芙，正在檢查我左腿被鱷魚咬過、已縫合的傷口。（現在想想，她完全沒理會首領。）和往常一樣，沒人料到我的模樣與表演。 我閉上眼睛，唱起「星之路，星之路」，開始落淚。「我是希絲，黑夜璀璨星途的女祭司。我被送到你們面前，帶來訊息。」鬍子老頭翻了白眼，首領卻一臉擔憂，全神貫注——正合我意。接著就是慣用把戲：我來自東方，我能解讀星辰，星辰帶我到需要我的地方，有可怕的警告，聽從我的智慧，諸如此類。 然後，我直視首領雙眼，描述正從東方逼近的藍死病。一種由濃如滾霧的蚊群帶來的疾病，會堵住呼吸的管道，抽走肌膚的血色，直到它變成淡藍。 鬍子老頭對首領低聲說了什麼。首領點頭，說在我康復前，會提供住處與食物。 彷彿他們還有別的選擇似的。

Though, I managed to have him order all people to wear body-covering clothing, as we do for winter, and rub pine needles on cloth and skin to mask the scent of our bodies. Seven fires burn across day and night, creating great plumes of smoke for deterring the death buzzing around us. They remain. 

Daneve has pored over the few medicinal books we have. She hardly sleeps. A few days ago, after examining the sick and their blue ears, fingers, lips, and toes, she realized the people had a respiratory infection causing “blood deoxygenation.” The discovery led her to collapse tearfully in my arms. We have no such thing as antibiotics.

不過，我還是說服他下令，讓所有人像過冬一樣，穿上遮住全身的衣服，用松針揉擦布料與皮膚，掩蓋身體的氣味。七堆火日夜不熄，升起大片濃煙，驅趕在周遭嗡嗡飛舞的死亡。牠們仍不肯離去。

丹妮芙翻遍我們僅有的幾本醫書，幾乎不睡覺。幾天前，她檢查病人發藍的耳朵、手指、嘴唇和腳趾，發現這是呼吸道感染造成的「血液缺氧」。這個發現讓她倒在我懷裡，哭了起來。我們根本沒有抗生素。

source: All the while, Seece, the quack priestess, postures and moans and chants and prays. She has gained a following of “Star Worshippers” and is now among the Chief’s spiritual advisors. Her antics are nothing but froth and distraction.
target: 與此同時，那個冒牌女祭司希絲，仍在裝腔作勢、呻吟、吟唱、祈禱。她已有一群「拜星者」追隨，如今更成為首領的精神顧問之一。她那些把戲，不過是空話與障眼法。

source: The mosquitoes arrived with summer and stayed. Buzzing gray clouds, as Seece predicted, regrettably. Blue Death surrounds us. One of the greatest frustrations as Science Advisor is reading all the survival guidebooks to find that burning lavender, citronella, and mint can keep mosquitoes away, but having none of these plants available to do so. Aslandia Blue Death is spreading through the tribe. Sick: 17 Dead: 9 Chief Ondomon has faltered in leadership, grieving his deceased son of three years.
target: 蚊群隨夏天到來，便不再離去。嗡嗡作響的灰雲，令人遺憾地印證了希絲的預言。藍死病包圍我們。身為科學顧問，最令人挫折的事之一，就是讀遍求生指南，知道燃燒薰衣草、香茅和薄荷能驅蚊，手邊卻一株也沒有。 阿斯蘭迪亞 藍死病正在部落蔓延。 染病：十七人 死亡：九人 翁多蒙首領失去三歲的兒子，沉浸悲痛，領導也陷入動搖。

source: Book of Observations: Year 2091, Vol. 2 Aug 2, 2091 World New beasts have appeared along with the mosquito swarms. Local seal populations are being slaughtered by Black Lashers — so called for their dark, slick skin and their powerful, whipping tails. Known as “orcas” by past peoples, these giant fish display ferocious tact and aggression. Equally fearsome are the Sea Bulls, which graze on the grasses and sea plants around Seal Island. I get confused looks when I call them “hippopotamuses.” Appearing calm, hulking, and slow is their deception – their bites have crushed two canoes used by the Oystermen.
target: 觀察錄：2091 年，第二卷 2091 年 8 月 2 日 世界 新野獸隨蚊群一同出現。本地海豹正遭「黑鞭獸」大量獵殺——這名字來自牠們黝黑光滑的皮膚，以及如鞭揮舞的強力尾巴。昔人稱牠們為「虎鯨」，這些巨魚展現出兇猛的戰術與攻擊性。同樣可怕的還有「海公牛」，在海豹島周圍啃食草與海生植物。我叫牠們「河馬」時，總換來困惑的目光。平靜、笨重、遲緩的外表只是欺騙——牠們已咬碎兩艘採蠔人的獨木舟。
